categories.main_business_segments: Qingdao TGOOD Electric Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main business segments: intelligent manufacturing and integrated services of outdoor box-type power equipment, and electric vehicle charging networks. The company focuses on smart box-type power equipment including high-voltage prefabricated modular substations and new energy box transformers, as well as the manufacturing and operation of electric vehicle charging infrastructure and related services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as digital and intelligent manufacturing, modular prefabricated substations, gas insulated switchgear (GIS), and smart charging systems with cloud-based management. It employs digital production lines, IoT-enabled workshops, and automated assembly lines to enhance production efficiency and product quality. Innovations include high-voltage digital prefabricated substations, liquid-cooled high-power charging modules, and AI-driven charging safety and operation models.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include new energy power generation groups, grid companies, railway systems, industrial and mining enterprises, data centers, and electric vehicle manufacturers. The company serves domestic and international markets with a focus on new energy, power grids, electric vehicles, and strategic emerging industries. Major clients include state-owned enterprises, large multinational energy companies, and leading automotive brands.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, covering provinces such as Shandong, Sichuan, Guangdong, and others, with a strong presence in urban and rural power grid upgrades. Internationally, it has expanded into over 56 countries and regions, focusing on Middle East, Africa, Central Asia, Europe, Southeast Asia, and the Pacific regions, aligning with the Belt and Road Initiative.
categories.supply_chain_position: Qingdao TGOOD Electric Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the power equipment and electric vehicle charging supply chains. It designs, manufactures, integrates, and services power distribution equipment and charging infrastructure, providing end-to-end solutions including equipment production, system integration, installation, and operation services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in smart manufacturing, digitalization, and integrated service models. R&D priorities include developing high-voltage prefabricated substations, advanced GIS products, high-power liquid-cooled charging modules, AI-based charging safety and operation models, and virtual power plant technologies. It aims to enhance product lifecycle management, reduce costs, and expand digital energy solutions to support carbon neutrality goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of power equipment and charging devices, system integration services, electric vehicle charging services, and value-added services such as energy management and SaaS platform offerings. The company also earns income from equipment leasing and financing services related to its core products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in China's outdoor box-type power equipment and electric vehicle charging network markets. It competes with global energy equipment giants like General Electric, Siemens, ABB, and Schneider Electric, and maintains strong strategic partnerships with them. Qingdao TGOOD is recognized as a technology and market leader domestically and is expanding its international footprint.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total operating revenue of approximately RMB 15.37 billion, representing a 21.15% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders reached RMB 916.56 million, an 86.62% increase. The company has shown steady growth in both domestic and overseas markets, with overseas business growing over 130%. It employs over 9,600 staff and continues to invest significantly in R&D and production capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Qingdao TGOOD Electric Co., Ltd. differentiates itself through its integrated one-stop EPCO service model, rapid deployment of modular prefabricated substations, advanced digital and intelligent manufacturing capabilities, and comprehensive lifecycle management solutions. Its charging network technology enables flexible, intelligent, and safe charging with large-scale aggregation and virtual power plant integration, supporting grid stability and renewable energy consumption. The company emphasizes high reliability, cost efficiency, and customer-centric innovation to maintain leadership in new energy and electric vehicle infrastructure sectors.
